comparison_unit: A frozen pretrained candidate backbone configuration together with its prospectively locked initialization identity, evaluated under the common CropCop CTC-v2 downstream training, validation, robustness and analysis protocol.
controlled_downstream_factors: AdamW optimizer family and frozen learning-rate schedule
final Pareto and lexicographic model-selection rule
recognized_nonisolated_factors: The four candidates do not share an identical upstream pretraining recipe or architecture-specific upstream optimization history, even though they remain within the broad ImageNet-1K transfer-learning regime.
R13 requires a prospectively frozen patch-embedding normalization-equivalence transform so that the common CTC-v2 normalized tensor preserves its upstream patch-embedding function.
Architecture family and frozen upstream pretrained initialization therefore cannot be causally separated by this Track-A design.

descriptive three-seed differences among the four frozen candidate systems
descriptive reliability, corruption robustness, class-tail, efficiency and XAI differences under the frozen protocol
engineering conclusions about the selected candidate within the CropCop study
forbidden_claims: one architecture family is intrinsically or universally superior to another
observed differences are caused solely by architecture independent of upstream pretrained initialization or recipe
Track-A results establish superiority outside the frozen CropCop data, training and candidate definitions
